result:
I think I found the cause of the startup timeout and fixed it, but I haven't compiled or run anything, so it is untested.

`trade-service/target/classes` is empty, which means trade-service failed to compile. The log you sent only shows discovery, user-service and market-service starting, with nothing from trade-service.

The cause was in `TradeController.java`. It imported both `org.springframework.amqp.core.*` and `java.util.*`. Both packages contain a `Queue` class, so the compiler reports an ambiguous reference. I replaced the wildcard import with explicit imports of `Binding`, `BindingBuilder`, `DirectExchange` and `Queue`.

I didn't touch the public API, the gateway configuration or the Compose topology. I haven't checked why `api-gateway/target/classes` is also missing. If the next run still times out, the trade-service log would be the one to look at.
